mapper.select: SELECT rule_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.productionImpact')) AS UNSIGNED) production_impact, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.notificationChannel')) notification_channel FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='ALERT_DRILL' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id)=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET domain_status='APPROVED', output_snapshot=JSON_SET(output_snapshot,'$.approvedBy',#{actor},'$.approvedAt',NOW(3)),completed_at=NOW(3) WHERE record_type='ALERT_ACCEPTANCE' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id)=#{id} AND domain_status='VALIDATED' AND user_id<>#{actor} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.routingOutcome'))='PASSED'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) id,rule_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.replayRunId')) AS UNSIGNED) replay_run_id, reference_entity_id drill_id,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.truePositive')) AS UNSIGNED) true_positive, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.falsePositive')) AS UNSIGNED) false_positive, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.falseNegative')) AS UNSIGNED) false_negative, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot,'$.trueNegative')) AS UNSIGNED) true_negative, JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.precisionRate') precision_rate,JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.recallRate') recall_rate, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.routingOutcome')) routing_outcome,content_sha256 evidence_sha256, domain_status status,user_id assessed_by,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(output_snapshot,'$.approvedBy')) AS UNSIGNED) approved_by, created_at assessed_at,completed_at approved_at FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='ALERT_ACCEPTANCE' AND rule_id=#{ruleId} ORDER BY legacy_source_id DESC
